title: agropyron trachycaulum var. tenerum
intro: Agropyron trachycaulum var. tenerum, commonly known as slender wheatgrass, is a perennial grass species native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of slender wheatgrass include its ability to act as an adaptogen, supporting the body's natural response to stress, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects, influencing the immune system's function. The bioactive constituents of slender wheatgrass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
